acceptance: AGENTS.md and sql_compat/README.md state the single query-translation entry point.
A blocking check flags text-level SQL rewriting in benchbox/core.
description:
## Problem
The rule that BenchBox query text reaches a platform only through translate_sql_query (and named fork rewrites via apply_rewrite) is recorded in an ADR that left the core repository in #3545 and in _project/decisions/sqlglot-fork-transpilation-plan.md, but AGENTS.md's BenchBox invariants and benchbox/sql_compat/README.md describe only DDL governance. A new benchmark loader therefore shipped hand-written per-platform token substitution of SQL text, and no automated check flags text-level SQL rewriting (tests/unit/sql_compat/test_vendored_sqlglot_bypass.py covers only direct vendored-SQLGlot calls; compat_lint covers only CREATE TABLE rewrites).

## Owner decision
- 2026-11-22: fix=[amend-items, schema-followup, guidance, lint], batch=resume-after (owner form answer 2026-11-22): 'New serial PR: state in AGENTS.md and sql_compat/README.md that query text reaches platforms only through translate_sql_query/apply_rewrite' and 'Add an automated check that flags text-level SQL rewriting in benchbox/core (the guidance PR would add it)'.

## Change
Add one invariant line to AGENTS.md (BenchBox invariants; keep the file compact) and a query-translation section to benchbox/sql_compat/README.md. Add a blocking check (test or make target wired into existing CI) that flags text-level rewriting of SQL in benchbox/core (e.g. str.replace/re.sub on SQL-bearing values, per-platform SQL substitution tables) outside the sanctioned modules, with a reviewed allowlist for legitimate existing cases (each listed with a reason in the PR). If the existing tree has violations that cannot be allowlisted with a reason, list them in the PR and file follow-ups instead of weakening the check.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the check fails on a fixture that does per-platform str.replace on SQL and passes on the tree; make comment-policy-check and pr-preflight pass.
